    Good modules from a preprojective component of Bᵢ(x) #

    Let C be a preprojective component over the quotient for B = Bᵢ(x) and U₀ ∈ C with no proper predecessor restricting to Rᵢ(x). Then A-predecessors of res U₀ are restrictions of predecessors of U₀ (predA_of_pred), and res U₀ is good (good_res).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.predA_of_pred {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] {D : DirData k A} (sd : (z : D.ι) → Decomp (D.RadP z)) (hsd : ∀ z ∈ D.T, D.SepDecomp z (sd z)) {x : D.ι} (i0 : (sd x).ι) {𝒞 : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0)) → Prop} (h𝒞 : PreprojComp 𝒞) {U₀ : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0))} (hU₀ : 𝒞 U₀) (habove : ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0))), 0 < m → PredN U₀ m V → ¬IsoM (resFD (D.qmap (Bset x (sd x) i0)) V) ((sd x).obj i0)) {n : ℕ} {Y : FDMod k A} :
    PredN (resFD (D.qmap (Bset x (sd x) i0)) U₀) n Y → ∃ (W : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0))), PredN U₀ n W ∧ IsoM Y (resFD (D.qmap (Bset x (sd x) i0)) W)

    A-predecessors of res U₀ come from predecessors of U₀.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.good_res {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] {D : DirData k A} (sd : (z : D.ι) → Decomp (D.RadP z)) (hsd : ∀ z ∈ D.T, D.SepDecomp z (sd z)) {x : D.ι} (i0 : (sd x).ι) {𝒞 : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0)) → Prop} (h𝒞 : PreprojComp 𝒞) {U₀ : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0))} (hU₀ : 𝒞 U₀) (habove : ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : FDMod k (D.QAlg (Bset x (sd x) i0))), 0 < m → PredN U₀ m V → ¬IsoM (resFD (D.qmap (Bset x (sd x) i0)) V) ((sd x).obj i0)) :
    Good (resFD (D.qmap (Bset x (sd x) i0)) U₀)
